policy: Every change to the base data is listed here with its evidence. Options are selectable rule variants; defaultOption is used unless a caller selects another. Base data is the default unless the evidence is decisive.

disputes.summary: Spirit Mask weight in the M4 Obsidian chest.

evidence.source: NotEnoughUpdates-REPO constants/rngscore.json (in-game RNG Meter copy, M4 updated 2026-02-25)
evidence.finding: All 22 M4 required scores fit total weight 296 with Spirit Mask weight 4 (required 22200). The data sums to 293 with Spirit Mask weight 1.
March 2026 change multiplied every M4 Obsidian weight by 4 and added Spirit Mask at weight 1.

disputes.summary: Top chest total weight used for RNG Meter required scores on M5 and M7.

evidence.finding: M5 scores imply total 326 (data 325) and list DYE_LIVID; M7 scores imply 13894 (data 13893) and list DYE_NECRON.

disputes.summary: Whether the F7 Obsidian chest has a guaranteed Wither Shard.

evidence.source: Community wiki The Catacombs - Floor VII/Loot

disputes.impact: Guaranteed entries do not affect rolled items.

disputes.summary: Emerald chest base cost on Floor 2.

evidence.source: Archived official wiki (January 2024), Fandom (2023), community wiki chest table

disputes.impact: Cost only. Affects cost-aware selection policies, not rolls.

knownGaps.summary: Livid Dye (M5 Bedrock) and Necron Dye (M7 Bedrock) are not in the base data and are not rolled.
knownGaps.evidence: Wiki shows a separate 1 in 5,000 / 1 in 2,500 roll. In-game meter totals imply a weight-1 pool entry. A 2025 forum post lists Necron Dye as weight 3. Mechanism unresolved.
knownGaps.consequence: Dyes cannot be scored. Floors marked PROVISIONAL.

knownGaps.summary: M7 Gold guaranteed essence (20 Undead, 18 Wither) is identical to F7 Gold; M6 Gold is 40 and 35.
knownGaps.evidence: Pattern only. No source gives a different value.
knownGaps.consequence: Essence amounts only. No alternative value available, so no override.

knownGaps.summary: Wiki lists the 50/50 Apex or Power Dragon Shard in Emerald, Obsidian and Bedrock; data has it in Bedrock only.
knownGaps.evidence: Community wiki M7 loot page versus base data.
knownGaps.consequence: Guaranteed entry. No effect on rolled items.

knownGaps.summary: Music disc replacement of essence is not modelled.
knownGaps.evidence: Archived official wiki says 1.6% of essence drops; community wiki and Fandom say 2% in Obsidian and Bedrock.
